sentences.en: Man, too, has been given protective devices against extreme temperatures.
sentences.zh: 人类也得到了一些装置来抵御极端温度。

sentences.en: All that's required is one injection and some electronic devices.
sentences.zh: 只需要一次注射和一些电子设备即可。

sentences.en: I don't know when you must turn off the device.
sentences.zh: 你得知道什么时候关闭这个装置。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：de+vice（代替）→代替人力的（东西）→装置
